name: Citizen's Assembly on the Future of Food (North-brabant, Netherlands)
content: Problems and Purpose Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation Influence, Outcomes, and Effects The official outcome was a Food Decree (Voedselbesluit), including the 40 proposals that were approved. It is unclear what the status of the document is, but it seems to be advisory. Analysis and Lessons Learned See Also References External Links Notes This entry is based on the POLITICIZE dataset.
